bagPolicy.summary: The athletics guide permits clear totes up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags, and nontransparent clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches; one bag per person. Medical bags are searched at marked medical lanes. This guide describes athletics events, so check the concert page for changes.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The athletics guide describes a VIP lot immediately south of the arena, approached from GT Blankenship Way, and event-specific general parking arrangements. Concert parking is not specified on this page.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published a specific rideshare pickup or drop-off location in its arena guide.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands are on the main and mid concourses; food, beverage, and retail sales are cashless. The guide prohibits outside food and drink.

accessibility.summary: An elevator is at the south end by Section 228, and private nursing rooms are available on request at either guest services kiosk. The guide describes elevator access for patrons with disabilities during basketball games.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The arena guide states that re-entry is not permitted.

ticketPickup.summary: The athletics box office at the east entrance opens one hour before tip-off; the guide does not give a concert will-call time.
